description: This Java source file defines a custom View class called PartyLightView for an Android application. It implements a flashing, color-cycling party light effect by smoothly transitioning between predefined colors using animated color interpolation.

classes.name: PartyLightView
classes.description: A custom Android View that displays flashing party lights by smoothly transitioning between multiple colors.
